summary: Isolate adopted governance runtime installation from system Python

delivery.outcome: Install governance runtime in an isolated job-local virtual environment on hosted and self-hosted runners; publish immutable 0.20.93 with regression evidence so adopters retain all required gates.
nonGoals: No system Python modification or PEP 668 bypass
No weakening required checks or merge approval
No changes to unrelated local main commit ticket-331 or workspace cleanup

architecture.decision: Workflow installation creates a job-local virtual environment, installs the selected standard runtime there, and exports its executable directory to later steps. Execute delivered shell blocks in deterministic fixtures, including installation failure and paths containing spaces.
architecture.rollback: Adopters retain previous immutable pin; revert source repair through protected delivery without moving published tags.

validation.evidence: Delivered installers avoid system pip, propagate installed runtime and reject failed installs; installed package and detached PR regressions pass.
Required checks remain present, release projections match, governance passes.

commands: Independent OneDev/Validator and declared Goal immutable publication
validation.evidence: Trusted exact-head approval, merge and immutable release precede adoption.
